5b7b85e81ee33e69.description:
We are looking for passionate and technically strong Java Developers to join our engineering team at a product-based technology company. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance software applications.
You will work on building robust backend systems, developing microservices, integrating APIs, and contributing to the architecture and continuous improvement of our products. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging technical problems, build scalable products, and collaborate with experienced engineering and product teams.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and related technologies.
• Build and implement RESTful APIs and microservices-based architectures.
• Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
• Develop and optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
• Work with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and JPA.
• Design, develop, and maintain database schemas, queries, and data models.
• Integrate third-party services, APIs, and internal systems.
• Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions.
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application defects and performance bottlenecks.
• Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams.
• Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure application quality.
• Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product development cycles.
• Contribute to continuous integration, deployment, and release management processes.
Required Technical Skills
• Strong programming experience in Java (Java 8/11/17 or above).
• Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Collections, Multithreading, and Exception Handling.
• Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Hibernate.
• Strong experience in developing REST APIs and microservices.
• Knowledge of SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
• Understanding of database design, indexing, query optimization, and transactions.
• Experience with Maven or Gradle.
• Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
• Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
• Experience in writing unit tests using JUnit and Mockito.
Good to Have Skills
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
• Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
• Understanding of Redis, Elasticsearch, or distributed caching.
• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• Knowledge of system design, design patterns, and distributed systems.
• Experience working on SaaS platforms or enterprise-grade software products.
• Exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular.
Experience Expectations
1–3 Years – Junior Java Developer
• Strong fundamentals in Core Java and OOP concepts.
• Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and REST API development.
• Basic understanding of databases, debugging, and testing.
• Ability to develop and maintain application modules under guidance.
3–5 Years – Java Developer
• Strong experience in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Microservices.
• Ability to independently develop backend modules and APIs.
• Experience in database optimization, debugging, and production support.
• Good understanding of design patterns and application architecture.
5–8 Years – Senior Java Developer
• Expertise in backend application development and microservices architecture.
• Ability to design scalable and high-performance applications.
• Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems, and database optimization.
• Experience in mentoring junior developers and conducting code reviews.
• Ability to drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
Preferred Candidate Profile
• Experience working in a product-based company or SaaS environment.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Passion for building scalable, high-quality software products.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within engineering teams.
• Strong communication and ownership mindset.
• Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving product requirements.
What We Offer
• Opportunity to work on innovative technology products.
• Exposure to modern engineering practices and scalable architectures.
• Collaborative and technically driven work environment.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
• Opportunity to contribute to product architecture and engineering decisions.
We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building products, solving complex technical challenges, and creating technology that delivers real business value.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. In this role, you'll focus on building and improving security automation, strengthening our SaaS environment, and developing scalable solutions that enhance security operations across the organization.

You'll leverage your programming and scripting skills, hands-on operations experience, and understanding of APIs, IAM permissions, and security best practices to solve complex technical challenges. You'll analyze code, troubleshoot technical issues, and apply risk-based thinking to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective security controls.

This is a highly autonomous, engineering-focused role where you'll have the opportunity to build security automations from the ground up, leverage AI to improve workflows, and solve challenging security problems. You'll work closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to streamline processes.

Our Core Technologies:

AWS (IAM, Security Services), Terraform, Python, Bash, REST APIs, AI/LLM Tools (Claude, AI Agents, MCP), Tines/SOAR, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, Sublime Security, SIGMA/YARA, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, FleetDM/osquery, GCP, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365.

What You’ll Do:

• Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual processes.

• Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform.

• Implement AWS security controls, including IAM policies and least-privilege access.

• Build secure integrations between systems using APIs and scripting.

• Identify, investigate, and resolve security risks across cloud infrastructure and internal systems.

• Use AI tools, agents, and MCP integrations to improve security workflows.

• Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, and security tools.

• Develop and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities.

• Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to implement security improvements.

• Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen security and automate processes.

What We Look For:

• Strong programming, scripting, and automation skills across one or more  languages.

• Hands-on AWS security experience, including IAM permissions and least-privilege principles.

• Strong Terraform skills, including independently writing and maintaining modules.

• Solid understanding of APIs, authentication, and secure integrations.

• Knowledge of security fundamentals, risk analysis, and cloud security best practices.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, and technical operations.

• Experience using AI development tools while independently validating generated code.

• Familiarity with AI agents, automation frameworks, or MCP integrations.

• Ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Tines or other SOAR platforms.

• Familiarity with CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, or Sublime Security.

• Experience with Sumo Logic or similar monitoring tools.

• Experience writing SIGMA or YARA detection rules.

• Understanding of event-driven architecture and enterprise IT systems.

• Experience with Kubernetes and container security.

• Knowledge of OWASP principles, including LLM/AI security.

• Experience with FleetDM, osquery, or endpoint security tools.

• Familiarity with GCP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Entra ID.

• Threat hunting or security investigation experience.

• Exposure to security compliance frameworks.

What Will Make You Successful:

• You take ownership and work independently with minimal direction.

• You identify problems and proactively develop solutions.

• You are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies.

• You use AI effectively without relying on it for every task, and are able to leverage your own knowledge and experience to challenge its assertions.

• You communicate openly and collaborate well across teams.

• You enjoy improving processes and making a measurable impact.

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($170k-$240k) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development 

• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Based Marketing Manager with vertical experience in Financial Services to design and execute highly targeted, data-driven ABM programs for our top strategic accounts—driving pipeline growth, accelerating deals, and increasing customer lifetime value. This role will focus on high-impact campaigns aligned to the Financial Services industry, leveraging industry-specific insights to personalize the buyer journey and deepen executive engagement.

This is a hands-on, strategic role that blends Financial Services vertical expertise, ABM strategy and execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of Financial Services industry pain points, collaborates closely with sales and marketing teams, and thrives in a high-growth, customer-centric environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Financial Services Vertical-Centric ABM Campaigns: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns for strategic accounts—tailoring messaging, content, and engagement strategies to Financial Services industry-specific challenges.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, field marketing, campaigns, and product marketing teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with account objectives, vertical GTM strategies, and buyer personas.
  • Data-Driven Insights & Reporting: Use tools like 6sense, Salesforce, and Tableau to monitor engagement, pipeline impact, and ROI. Translate insights into clear campaign optimizations and business recommendations.
  • Executive Engagement: Collaborate with sales leaders to develop executive-level programs that drive alignment and trust with C-level buyers in Financial Services. 
  • ABM Innovation & Enablement: Drive new tactics such as themed call blitzes, strategic gifting, and multi-channel personalization. Enable sellers with tailored playbooks and outbound messaging aligned to industry pain points.
  • Mentorship & Best Practices: Support junior ABM teammates by sharing playbooks, insights, and vertical knowledge to scale successful programs across regions.
  • Budget Management: Manage and optimize ABM budgets, ensuring effective use of resources and clear tracking of program performance.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of B2B field marketing experience, with at least 5+ years focused on ABM and/or strategic account marketing in enterprise tech or SaaS environments.
  • Proven vertical marketing expertise—ideally in Financial Services—with the ability to speak to industry-specific trends, buyer needs, and GTM motions.
  • Advanced proficiency in ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase), Salesforce CRM, and analytics tools such as Tableau.
  • Strong understanding of the customer journey, multi-touch attribution, and end-to-end campaign development.
  • Excellent project management and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working across sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience enabling sales teams with tailored messaging and account-based strategies.
  • Team mentorship or leadership experience is a plus.
  • Flexibility to travel up to 50%. This includes time in London with our Sales team and also across our main hubs in the EMEA region for events / meetings with local Field Marketing teams, as required

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline contribution and acceleration from strategic vertical accounts
  • Engagement and conversion within targeted industries
  • Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction (particularly sales and vertical leaders)
  • ROI and efficiency of ABM program spend
  • Internal adoption of ABM best practices and frameworks

Opportunities for Growth

This is a high-visibility role with a strong path toward ABM leadership, vertical strategy, or demand generation ownership. You’ll have a direct impact on shaping how Pure Storage grows in high-potential industries—and how we build lasting relationships with our most important customers.
